statement: All explicit finite global function field towers admit ordinary field factorization and enumeration of every place with finite residue fields valuations Laurent jets and approximation
notes: Inseparable towers are included. Every place is supplied by a finite pointed standard-etale certificate with an injective computable Laurent expansion; duplicates in the enumeration are allowed. No completed-field factorization or effective normalization oracle is used.

statement: Every finite central simple algebra over every explicit global function field has ordinary splitting index actual division-factor matrix-unit and reduced-norm algorithms including wild degree
notes: The projective splitting variety and finite local congruence obstructions give complementary terminating searches via ABHN. Global period=index computes the exact minimal left-ideal dimension; actual idempotents and matrix units then give the division factor. No efficiency or prime-to-characteristic hypothesis is imposed.

statement: All finite-dimensional algebras over explicit global function fields admit ordinary radical and certified semisimple decomposition algorithms with actual division factors centers and primitive lifts
notes: An invertible two-sided action map certifies each positive-dimensional central simple target; a surjective quotient with nilpotent kernel identifies the radical. Arbitrary finite center towers including inseparable ones are enumerated and verified. Nilpotent lifting gives actual complete orthogonal primitive idempotents.
